name: Cortical cataract
summary: Wedge-shaped opacities (spokes) in the peripheral cortex pointing to the centre; dark against the red reflex.
severity_scale: Cortical 1-4 (approximately LOCS III C1-C5 by area)

revealed_by.retroillumination: Dark radial spokes silhouetted against the red reflex, often inferonasal first.
revealed_by.optic_section_lens: White wedge opacities in the peripheral cortex.

teaching_points: Use retroillumination through a dilated pupil to see spokes.
Spokes that reach the visual axis cause glare.

provenance.source: LOCS III: Chylack et al. (1993); values render-calibrated
